Also LiveAuctioneers/Invaluable results and Noble Numismatics, Leski, Mossgreen/Davidson for the same terms; check dealer asking prices (Hansons, Bonhams, Dominic Winter signed Mountbatten) and autograph authentication notes (PSA/DNA, Spink). viewing_check: Photograph the card front and back at the viewing: signature ink and pressure (real ink, not printed or secretarial), Government House heading (which one, Delhi or Vice-regal 1947-48 matters), date on the menu, any provenance note or envelope; check the signature does not look printed or stamped. Also check hallmark on the filigree silver boat.
